name: I-Hwa Industrial Co.,Ltd
summary: I-Hwa Industrial Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise primarily involved in two key areas: textiles and real estate. Its textile division handles the manufacturing, processing, and distribution of textile products. In its real estate segment, the company undertakes property investment, development, leasing, and sales. Founded in 1968, I-Hwa Industrial is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
